messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (signal) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is this a problem with Keelwater's product that a squad could act on? Pass means yes.
Fail if the cause is outside the product (pricing, contracts, the customer's own IT, staffing), if a help article would have answered it, or if it is praise.
A feature request or a described workaround is signal.
The evidence is the title, the problem statement and up to 12 customer quotes with route and date.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "title": "Delayed Payments and Settlements",
 "problem_statement": "Supplier payments and claim settlements are being held up due to system delays in processing, reserves management, and task visibility. This causes financial disruptions and erodes supplier trust.",
 "quotes": [
  {
   "quote": "We’re still seeing some delays with the webhook retries on our supplier payments module, and it’s causing issues with how we process claims and update policyholders in real time.",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-10-22T16:09:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Exactly. It’s not just inconvenient — it’s holding up payments and supplier invoices too.",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-10-17T16:58:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "We’ve been reviewing how claims and documents flow through our current system, and it’s causing delays in reserves and payments.",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-10-17T13:44:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Also, our finance team needs clearer reporting on reserves versus actual payments — it’s ... causing delays in supplier reconciliation.",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-10-16T12:52:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "we rely on those tasks being visible to avoid delays with supplier payments",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-09-15T09:51:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "I think we need a clearer way to manage reserves and supplier payments.",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-09-06T10:49:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Appreciate that — we need to avoid any more delays in payments or supplier settlements.",
   "route": "account_management",
   "date": "2026-09-17T13:03:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "quote": "it’s been holding up payments and suppliers are starting to ask questions",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-28T08:19:00+00:00"
  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>
